error_categories.dirty_paths_outside_scope: submit_task rejects a dirty baseline whose paths are not covered by allowed_paths.
error_categories.dirty_workspace: submit_task rejects pre-existing dirty paths unless allow_dirty=true; `dirty_paths` is sorted.
error_categories.empty_task: submit_task requires a non-blank task text.
error_categories.git_snapshot_failed: submit_task could not take the Git snapshot (GitError); detail is not contract.
error_categories.invalid_allowed_paths: submit_task rejected allowed_paths: empty list, absolute main-workspace path, or path outside trusted external roots; detail is not contract.
error_categories.invalid_git_policy: submit_task requires allow_dirty and allow_commit to be booleans.
error_categories.invalid_request: request_changes requires a non-empty request_id and non-blank findings.
error_categories.invalid_request_id: submit_task requires a non-empty string request_id.
error_categories.invalid_test_commands: submit_task rejected a test command before any task/command ran; carries `index` and a safe `reason`, never the command text.
error_categories.invalid_verbose: task_status requires verbose to be a boolean.
error_categories.invalid_wait_seconds: task_status requires wait_seconds to be an integer in 0..300.
error_categories.no_active_task: task_status without task_id reports that no active task exists for the project.
error_categories.not_a_git_repo: submit_task requires the workspace to be a Git repository.
error_categories.not_awaiting_review: request_changes/accept_task require an awaiting_review task; carries the actual `status`.
error_categories.project_busy: submit_task rejected a second concurrent task for the same project.
error_categories.request_conflict: A request_id was reused with a different payload, kind or task.
error_categories.revision_limit: request_changes reached max_rounds; the task is moved to needs_user without sending a new round.
error_categories.server_busy: accept_task/close_task refused while OpenCode reports the session busy or retrying.
error_categories.server_unavailable: OpenCode health/path/status probe failed; accept_task may append a ${DETAIL} suffix, close_task returns the bare category.
error_categories.server_unhealthy: OpenCode health probe reported healthy != true.
error_categories.server_wrong_directory: OpenCode /path did not return the configured workspace directory.
error_categories.unknown_task: The requested task_id does not exist.
error_categories.worker_running: accept_task refused while the project worker lock is held.

normalization_rules.absolute_paths: Every absolute filesystem path is replaced by its documented placeholder (${WORKSPACE}, ${EXTERNAL_REPO}, ${FOREIGN_PATH}, ${FIXTURE_DIR}); paths inside an external repository keep the `${EXTERNAL_REPO}/<relative>` form in flat lists and stay repository-relative inside `repositories[]`.
normalization_rules.commands: user_action.command and user_action.fallback_command are compared after replacing the shlex-joined argv with ${CONSOLE_COMMAND}/${ATTACH_COMMAND}; tokens and quoting are contract, absolute config/state paths are not.
normalization_rules.deadlines_and_durations: worker.started_at/deadline_at and verification command durations are replaced by ${TIMESTAMP}/${DURATION}; only presence, ordering and shape are contract.
normalization_rules.error_detail: Free-form `detail` and probe/exception suffixes are replaced by ${DETAIL} and never compared; the stable `error` category is the contract.
normalization_rules.git_fingerprints: Git HEAD hashes and index/worktree fingerprints are replaced by ${HEAD_BEFORE}/${HEAD_AFTER}/${FINGERPRINT}; comparisons use equality or movement, never exact hashes.
normalization_rules.message_ids: OpenCode outbound/response message ids are replaced by ${MESSAGE_ID}.
normalization_rules.request_ids: MCP request_id values are stable synthetic literals (${REQUEST_ID}, ${REVISION_REQUEST_ID}); they participate in idempotency/conflict semantics.
normalization_rules.session_ids: OpenCode session ids are replaced by ${SESSION_ID}/${REVISION_SESSION_ID}; user_action.session_title keeps the deterministic `agent-bridge ${TASK_ID} round <n>` form.
normalization_rules.task_ids: UUID task ids are replaced by the stable synthetic ${TASK_ID}/${OTHER_TASK_ID}.
normalization_rules.timestamps: created_at/updated_at/close_requested_at ISO-8601 values are replaced by ${TIMESTAMP}; exact clock values are not contract.
normalization_rules.verification_output: verification.commands[].output_tail is a bounded tail for failed commands only and is replaced by ${OUTPUT_TAIL}; the full log stays in the private state dir behind the relative `log` path.

placeholder_conventions.${CONFIG_PATH}: Absolute path of the projects.toml used to build console/attach commands.
placeholder_conventions.${DETAIL}: Free-form probe/exception detail appended after a category prefix; never compared.
placeholder_conventions.${DURATION}: Normalized duration in seconds (verification command runtime); exact value is not contract.
placeholder_conventions.${EXTERNAL_DIRTY_PATH}: Absolute path `${EXTERNAL_REPO}/lib.py` of a pre-existing dirty file in the external repository.
placeholder_conventions.${EXTERNAL_REPO}: Absolute canonical path of a configured trusted external Git repository root.
placeholder_conventions.${FINGERPRINT}: Normalized Git index/worktree fingerprint; compared only for equality/inequality.
placeholder_conventions.${FIXTURE_DIR}: Absolute path of the materialized fixture directory.
placeholder_conventions.${FOREIGN_PATH}: Absolute path of a foreign OpenCode server root returned by /path.
placeholder_conventions.${OUTPUT_TAIL}: Bounded output tail of a failed verification command; exact text is not contract.
placeholder_conventions.${REQUEST_ID}: Stable synthetic initial submit request id (`req-1`).
placeholder_conventions.${STATE_ROOT}: Absolute state root used to build console/attach commands.
placeholder_conventions.${TASK_ID}: Stable synthetic task id (`task-1`); a real UUID is normalized to this placeholder.
placeholder_conventions.${WORKSPACE}: Absolute canonical path of the project workspace (a Git repository).
